# Exploration of data from Tanner (2018)

```{r}
library(tidytable)
library(ggplot2)

setwd("experiment2")
```

## Preprocessed data
Preprocessed EEG (see ``src/eeg_preprocessing_tanner.r``)
```{r}
mean_amplitude <- read.csv(file.path("data", "Tanner", "mean_amplitude.csv"))
```

```{r}
mean_amplitude |> head()
mean_amplitude |> summary()
```

## Extracted semantic association
```{r}
sem_assoc <- read.csv(file.path("results", "tanner_semantic_association.csv")) |>
    select(-X)
```

```{r}
sem_assoc |> head()
sem_assoc |> nrow()
```

```{r}
mean_amplitude |>
    left_join(sem_assoc) |>
    filter(target == "neighbor") |>
    select(context, target, semantic_association, model, subject, n400)
```
